case_number: 2024 INSC 424; REVIEW PETITION (CIVIL) NO.526 OF 2023 IN CIVIL APPEAL NO.6990 OF 2014
summary: Constitutional challenge to amendment inserting Section 2(g)(6) in Haryana Village Common Lands Act; scope of 'shamilat deh' lands; validity of amendment clarifying inclusion of lands entered as Jumla Malkan; interplay between East Punjab Holdings Act provisions (Sections 18/23A/24) and common lands regulation; review petition challenging appeal judgment; Constitution Bench precedents on land ownership and consolidation schemes (Ranjit Singh, Ajit Singh, Bhagat Ram); amendment upheld as declaratory not substantive; common purpose lands vest in Gram Panchayat only if expressly earmarked in consolidation scheme; appeal judgment sustaining amendment confirmed.
legal_provisions_cited: East Punjab Holdings (Consolidation and Prevention of Fragmentation) Act, 1948 s.18, s.23-A, s.24
Punjab Village Common Lands (Regulation) Act, 1961 s.2(g)
final_judgment: Review petition dismissed; judgment under review (dated 07.04.2022 allowing Civil Appeal No. 6990 of 2014) upheld; amendment to Haryana Village Common Lands Act validated; landowners' writ petition dismissed.
